Tamper Check is a free browser tool that checks whether a Ledger hardware wallet was physically tampered with — mostly using a kitchen scale and software. You tare the scale, weigh the wallet three times against a same-batch reference unit, and if it reads 0.3 g or more over, that's TAMPERED; weight and centre-of-mass agreeing raises confidence.

It's at https://aileena.xyz/tools/tamper-check, with the code at https://github.com/lilaclilac09/tamper-check.
